hypothesis.customerProblem: Small industrial waste coordinators may find it difficult to reconcile shipment references and correction follow-up notes.
hypothesis.buyerTrigger: A waste shipment record is received for internal follow-up or a manifest correction is requested.
hypothesis.expensiveFailure: Missing correction references can prolong internal reconciliation of shipment documentation between handlers.
hypothesis.discoveryQuestion: How does the operations team trace open manifest correction requests and the associated shipment files today?
hypothesis.differentiator: Separate manifest reference, correction follow-up, handler response and final internal review into one traceable queue.

recipe.title: Manifest Exception Review Desk
recipe.buyer: Industrial service coordinators organizing hazardous-waste shipment paperwork
recipe.outcome: Organize local manifest follow-up evidence; this does not create, sign or certify EPA manifests.
